title_en: Notice of the Office of the Central Organizational Establishment Committee and the Supreme People's Court on Actively Promoting the Reform of Internal Institutions of People's Courts below the Provincial Level
full_text_en:
Central Organization Establishment Committee Office  Supreme People's Court

Notice on Actively Promoting the Reform of Internal Institutions in People's Courts Below the Provincial Level

Fa Fa [2018] No. 8

Organization Establishment Offices and High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; Organization Establishment Office of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps; Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

To earnestly implement the spirit of the "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Deepening the Reform of Party and State Institutions" and the central government's decisions and deployments on deepening the reform of the judicial system, and to actively promote the reform of internal institutions in people's courts below the provincial level, notice on relevant issues is hereby given as follows:

1. On the Number of Internal Institutions. The principle of optimizing synergy and efficiency shall be adhered to. On the basis of rationalizing functions and optimizing division of labor, internal institutions shall be streamlined, the scale of internal institutions shall be strictly controlled, and the phenomenon of one-person or two-person divisions (sections, offices) shall be eliminated. Flat management shall be implemented to reduce management levels, optimize work processes, and improve operational quality and efficiency. For basic people's courts with 50 or fewer (including this number, the same below) political and legal special staffing positions, the total number of internal institutions shall generally not exceed 5; for those with 51 to 100 positions, generally not exceed 8; for those with 101 to 200 positions, generally not exceed 10; for those with heavier work tasks or with 201 or more positions, trial (adjudication) departments may be appropriately increased upon strict approval based on work needs. High and intermediate people's courts shall appropriately reduce the number of internal institutions based on factors such as trial level functions, case volume, and staffing. The number of non-trial departments in people's courts at all levels shall not exceed the number of trial departments. The institutional setup of higher-level courts and lower-level courts need not correspond one-to-one; higher-level courts shall not require lower-level courts to set up corresponding institutions, nor shall they restrict lower-level courts from integrating internal institutions through means such as assessments, evaluations, or fund allocation. People's tribunals of basic people's courts are not covered by the reform scope of internal institutions. Discipline inspection and supervision institutions shall be set up in accordance with relevant central regulations.

2. On the Establishment of Trial Departments and the Formation of Trial Teams. The optimization of trial functions and flat internal management shall be actively promoted, and trial management and supervision shall be strengthened. People's courts at all levels may set up trial departments according to trial work needs. Courts with relatively fewer staffing positions may set up a comprehensive trial division or no trial division. Trial teams shall be flexibly formed based on actual circumstances such as case volume, case types, difficulty levels, and personnel structure. The reform of the trial power operation mechanism shall be further advanced, the principal role of judges and collegial panels in handling cases shall be implemented, and the quality and efficiency of case handling shall be improved.

3. On the Construction of Specialized Trial Organizations. To meet the needs of economic and social development and improve the level of specialization in trials, basic people's courts with the necessary conditions may, within the prescribed total number of internal institutions, explore forms of specialized trial organization based on actual circumstances such as case volume, case types, handling judges, and staffing. Where case volume and the number of judges are relatively small, specialized collegial panels or trial teams may be established within relevant trial divisions.

4. On the Establishment of Non-Trial Departments. Non-trial departments with overlapping functions or similar business shall be integrated, and departments without direct connection to the functions of the adjudicatory organ shall be abolished. Corresponding institutions shall be established comprehensively according to functions such as political work and party affairs, judicial administration, and judicial affairs. The relationship of powers and responsibilities shall be clarified, the division of work shall be optimized, operational mechanisms shall be improved, and work efficiency shall be enhanced.

5. On the Standardized Establishment of Internal Institutions. Within the same province (autonomous region, municipality directly under the Central Government), the number, responsibilities, and names of internal institutions among courts at the same level with similar staffing sizes and case volumes shall be relatively uniform. Internal institutions shall be established strictly in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Organic Law of the People's Courts, and the names of trial divisions shall be standardized and not set arbitrarily. Except for case filing departments (litigation service centers) and enforcement departments, trial departments shall be called "XX Division" and no other names shall be used. The approval procedure shall be strictly followed. Reform plans for internal institutions of basic and intermediate people's courts shall be implemented after review by the High People's Court and approval by the provincial-level institution establishment competent department, and shall be reported to the Supreme People's Court for recordation. Reform plans for internal institutions of High People's Courts shall, after soliciting opinions from the Supreme People's Court, be implemented after review by the provincial-level institution establishment competent department and approval by the provincial-level Party Committee, and shall be reported to the central institution establishment competent department and the Supreme People's Court for recordation.

For basic people's courts with a total number of internal institutions not exceeding 5, institutions such as the Case Filing Division (Litigation Service Center), Comprehensive Trial Division, Enforcement Bureau, Political Department (Party Committee Office), and Comprehensive Office (Judicial Police Brigade) may be established. For basic people's courts with a total number of internal institutions not exceeding 8, institutions such as the Case Filing Division (Litigation Service Center), Criminal Trial Division, Civil Trial Division, Administrative Trial Division (Comprehensive Trial Division), Enforcement Bureau, Political Department (Party Committee Office), Comprehensive Office (Judicial Police Brigade), and Trial Management Office (Research Office) may be established. For basic people's courts with a total number of internal institutions not exceeding 10, institutions such as the Case Filing Division (Litigation Service Center), Criminal Trial Division, Civil Trial Division No. 1, Civil Trial Division No. 2, Administrative Trial Division (Comprehensive Trial Division), Enforcement Bureau, Political Department (Party Committee Office), Comprehensive Office, Trial Management Office (Research Office), and Judicial Police Brigade may be established. Within the limits of the total number of internal institutions, basic people's courts may determine the names of institutions based on actual conditions. High and intermediate people's courts may make appropriate adjustments based on trial level functions, case jurisdiction, staffing, and other circumstances.

6. On the Use of Leadership Positions. After the integration of internal institutions, the relevant leadership positions shall not be reduced. People's courts at all levels shall strengthen communication and coordination with organizational departments and institution establishment departments, and solidly carry out the verification and use of leadership and non-leadership positions, as well as the reassignment and placement of original leading cadres after the streamlining of internal institutions, with their positions, ranks, and related treatment remaining unchanged. Local people's courts at all levels shall consult with the organization departments and political and legal affairs committees of the same-level Party committees to actively explore ways and means for the reasonable arrangement of relevant leading cadres after the reform. The reform of the rank sequence system for judge assistants and court clerks shall be earnestly promoted, and in conjunction with the parallel reform of civil servant positions and ranks, efforts shall be made to expand the career development space for trial support personnel and judicial administrative personnel. Emphasis shall be placed on strengthening ideological and political work, fully mobilizing the work enthusiasm of various types of court personnel, and ensuring the stability of the cadre team in people's courts.

7. On the Deadline for Completing the Reform. All provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government) shall fully launch the reform of internal institutions in basic people's courts. High and intermediate people's courts where reform conditions are relatively mature may actively carry out the reform based on actual conditions. Basic people's courts and high and intermediate people's courts carrying out the reform of internal institutions shall form reform plans for internal institutions before the end of 2018, complete the approval procedures, and report them to the Supreme People's Court for recordation. The tasks of the reform of internal institutions shall be basically completed before the end of March 2019. If it is difficult to complete within the time limit, the relevant High People's Court shall make a special report to the Supreme People's Court and the provincial-level Party Committee Political and Legal Affairs Committee and Organization Establishment Office.

8. On Reform Supervision and Guidance. People's courts at all levels shall resolutely implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the Supreme People's Court, follow the laws of justice, combine local realities, and actively and steadily promote the reform of internal institutions. High People's Courts shall earnestly assume the main responsibility for the reform, strengthen the organization and leadership of the reform of internal institutions in courts within their jurisdiction,细化 implement the requirements for the reform of internal institutions, guide the formulation of reform plans for internal institutions, strengthen supervision and guidance over the reform of internal institutions, enhance communication and coordination with provincial-level institution establishment competent departments, and ensure the timely and successful completion of the tasks of the reform of internal institutions. The Supreme People's Court will effectively strengthen the supervision and guidance of the reform, will provide timely supervision for courts with slower reform progress, and will notify and require rectification for courts that violate laws or regulations in the reform. Provincial-level institution establishment competent departments shall actively support the reform of internal institutions in people's courts, strengthen work guidance and coordination, form a work synergy, and accelerate work progress.

Any issues and suggestions arising during implementation shall be promptly reported to the Central Organization Establishment Committee Office and the Supreme People's Court.

May 25, 2018
